Source: @bamotamem

A few books (1) To update my journal after seven or eight months, I thought the easiest thing I could write would be a list of a few books I've read in recent months. I've written some of it and published it for now. I'll publish the second part later (or complete this one). It's nothing too special. The mood is completely personal. But maybe you'd like to see this list and my explanations: https://mrshabanali.com/books1/
